## Summary

* What resource(s) are you adding or changing?
* Which README section?

## Checklist

* [ ] Free or meaningfully freemium, and legal to access
* [ ] Not a duplicate of an existing entry
* [ ] Placed in the correct roadmap / tools / practice section
* [ ] One-line description + difficulty (`Beginner` / `Intermediate` / `Advanced`)
* [ ] Link opens and is the official or canonical URL
